description:
About the role

Nupsala is a specialist veterinary products distributor working across around 20 European countries. We are looking for a full-time developer to own the technical side of all our group websites, which run on WordPress with Elementor, and our WooCommerce shops.

This is not a ticket-taking job. You will tell us what the sites need, set the priorities with us, and then make it happen. You will report to the Marketing Manager and work every day with the marketing team.

What you will do

•     Build, maintain and improve all Nupsala group websites and e-commerce shops.

•     Lead a redesign of the front end across our sites, with a strong eye for clean, modern, professional design. The sites should feel like one family.

•     Optimize the back end. Clean up and speed up themes, plugins, custom code and the database, so the sites are lean, fast and stable.

•     Own security, performance and stability. This means regular core, theme and plugin updates, PHP version management, backups and monitoring, and finding the cause of hosting and server problems.

•     Run a quarterly audit of our tech stack and come back with clear, prioritized suggestions for improvement.

•     Apply WordPress SEO best practice, so our sites are easy to find in every market we sell in.

•     Connect our sites to Zoho CRM, so orders, customers and leads sync cleanly and the team does not copy data by hand.

•     Design and build a mobile-first web shop for veterinarians. It should feel close to a mobile app, with one simple customer journey across phone, tablet and desktop.

•     Document how everything is set up, so the sites can always be handed over or covered by someone else.

Your first six months

Months 1: audit and stabilize the current sites. Put solid security, update and backup routines in place.

Months 2-3: fix the most important performance, SEO and integration issues.

Months 4 to 6: begin work on Nupsala UK mobile-first e-com vet shop, with a clear plan for the EU.

After six months we expect stable, secure and well-documented sites, a clear improvement plan, and the first version of the e-com vet shop under way.

 

 What we are looking for

•     Strong hands-on experience with WordPress, Elementor and WooCommerce.

•     A genuine eye for design, backed by comfort in the code. You do not need to be a full software engineer, but you should be able to edit PHP, CSS and JavaScript to get the result you want, and not be limited by page builders.

•     A solid understanding of WordPress security, common vulnerabilities and PHP.

•     Proven mobile UI and responsive design skills. These are essential for this role.

•     Experience maintaining and auditing plugins.

•     A working grasp of SEO within WordPress.

•     Clear English and a self-managed, proactive way of working.

•     Someone who looks ahead and is open to changing our tech stack as our needs and the technology change.

Good nice to have

•     Experience with Zoho CRM or similar, and with connecting CRM or ERP systems to a website through plugins, APIs or automation tools.

•     Familiarity with B2B or wholesale WooCommerce setups.

•     Experience with headless architectures such as Next.js. We are exploring a gradual move toward a leaner, safer and lighter setup over time. This is a future direction, not part of the first six months.

•     UX thinking for professional users.

Location and salary

Location. Preferably based in, or willing to relocate to, Brașov (Cristian), with some days in the office and flexibility to work from home.

Salary. 6,500 to 7,600 RON net per month, depending on experience.

What we offer

A full-time role with real ownership across a multi-country group. You will work directly with the marketing team and have the chance to shape the technical direction of our websites, and of a vet-facing shop, from the ground up.
